name: heat_limit
value: The display can heat up considerably; do not touch the combi
quote: The display in particular can heat up considerably at ambient temperatures above 55 °C (131 °F) during long periods of inactivity, e.g. at traffic lights, or in direct sunlight.

name: Air filter check and replacement in dusty conditions
quote: In dusty conditions, it may be necessary to check and replace the air filter more frequently, possibly even daily.

name: air_filter_check
value: Check the air filter regularly and replace if necessary.
quote: * In dusty operating conditions: Check the air filter regularly and replace if necessary.

name: salt_wash
quote: If the vehicle was driven in road salt, clean it with cold water.

name: salt_wash
value: Brake carefully several times to remove salt from the brake
quote: Brake carefully several times to remove salt from the brake linings and the brake discs. WARNING Danger of accidents Oil, grease or wax on the brake discs reduces the brake action. - Always keep the brake discs free of oil, fat and wax. - C
